name: advanced tuck back lever
description: A back lever hold with the knees still bent but the hips opened so the back is flat. It is noticeably longer than the tuck.
instructions: Get into a tuck back lever with straight arms.
Push your hips back until your back is flat and level.
Keep your knees bent at roughly a right angle.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your arms locked.
Hold, then tuck in and exit through the german hang.
